# puppeteer-termux

Puppeteer dengan dukungan penuh untuk **Termux** (Android). Fork dari [puppeteer-real-browser](https://github.com/zfcsoftware/puppeteer-real-browser) dengan tambahan:

- Deteksi otomatis lingkungan Termux
- Auto-detect path Chromium di Termux
- Gunakan `xvfb-run` (bukan npm `xvfb`) untuk mode headful di Android
- Injeksi flag Chrome esensial untuk Termux secara otomatis
- Export utilitas `isTermux()` dan `getTermuxChromePath()`
- Tetap kompatibel penuh dengan Linux desktop biasa

---

## Instalasi

### Di Termux (Android)

```bash
pkg install nodejs chromium
pkg install xorg-server-xvfb   # hanya jika mau pakai headless: false
npm i puppeteer-termux
```

### Di Linux Desktop

```bash
sudo apt-get install xvfb
npm i puppeteer-termux
```

---

## Penggunaan

### CommonJS

```js
const { connect } = require("puppeteer-termux");

async function main() {
  const { browser, page } = await connect({
    headless: false,
    turnstile: true,
  });
  await page.goto("https://example.com");
}

main();
```

### ESM / Module

```js
import { connect } from "puppeteer-termux";

const { browser, page } = await connect({
  headless: false,
  turnstile: true,
});
await page.goto("https://example.com");
```

---

## Opsi `connect()`

```js
const { connect } = require("puppeteer-termux");

const { browser, page } = await connect({
  headless: false,         // false = headful (pakai xvfb-run di Termux)
                           // true / "shell" = headless (tanpa display)
  args: [],                // flag Chrome tambahan
  customConfig: {},        // opsi chrome-launcher (termasuk chromePath)
  turnstile: true,         // auto-solve Cloudflare Turnstile
  connectOption: {},       // opsi puppeteer.connect()
  disableXvfb: false,      // true = jangan pakai xvfb/xvfb-run sama sekali
  ignoreAllFlags: false,   // true = abaikan semua flag default
                           // (flag esensial Termux tetap diinjeksi)
  plugins: [],             // plugin puppeteer-extra
  // proxy: {
  //   host: "127.0.0.1",
  //   port: 8080,
  //   username: "user",
  //   password: "pass",
  // },
});
```

### Flag esensial yang selalu diinjeksi di Termux

Meski `ignoreAllFlags: true`, flag berikut selalu ditambahkan otomatis:

| Flag | Alasan |
|---|---|
| `--no-sandbox` | Termux tidak punya setuid sandbox |
| `--disable-setuid-sandbox` | Diperlukan bersama `--no-sandbox` |
| `--disable-dev-shm-usage` | Android tidak punya `/dev/shm` |
| `--disable-gpu` | GPU tidak tersedia di Termux |
| `--no-first-run` | Skip halaman first-run Chrome |
| `--no-zygote` | Android tidak support zygote process |

---

## Utilitas Termux

```js
const { connect, isTermux, getTermuxChromePath } = require("puppeteer-termux");

console.log(isTermux());            // true / false
console.log(getTermuxChromePath()); // "/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/chromium-browser"
```

---

## Fitur ghost-cursor

Library ini menyertakan [ghost-cursor](https://github.com/Xetera/ghost-cursor) untuk simulasi gerakan mouse yang realistis.

```js
// Gunakan realClick untuk klik yang lebih natural
await page.realClick("#tombol");

// Akses cursor langsung
await page.realCursor.move("#elemen");
```

---

## Penggunaan dengan Plugin puppeteer-extra

```bash
npm i puppeteer-extra-plugin-click-and-wait
```

```js
const { connect } = require("puppeteer-termux");

const { browser, page } = await connect({
  headless: false,
  plugins: [require("puppeteer-extra-plugin-click-and-wait")()],
});
await page.goto("https://example.com");
await page.clickAndWaitForNavigation("a");
await browser.close();
```

---

## Docker

```dockerfile
FROM node:latest

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    chromium \
    xvfb \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```
